overview: The Trade Depot Storage Vaults are the logistical heart of Shar Vahl’s crafting economy, storing materials and goods for artisans and merchants.
history: The vaults were carved into the sandstone beneath Artisan Ward.
Clan commissions began using the vaults for secure storage.
Arcane seals were added to protect valuable goods.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the vaults were expanded with new lift platforms.
Market Terraces merchants established direct supply routes to the vaults.
hooks: A crate seal fails, releasing unstable arcane energy.
A supply lift jams, delaying critical materials.
A clan commission crate goes missing.
A vault collapse threatens stored goods.
